title: Two gas-fired furnaces and two enclosed cooling boxes share one fork charging car
summary: One car moves each batch from a Suneng gas-fired furnace to a free cooling box. The line has two furnaces and two enclosed boxes. The quoted supply includes five sets of heat-resistant trays with two pieces per set.
seoTitle: Two gas furnaces and two enclosed cooling boxes
seoDescription: The 2020 line uses one fork car between two furnaces and two enclosed cooling boxes. Check tray supply, sequencing and transfer responsibilities.

features: Heating and cooling occupy separate stations
The car moves a batch from the furnace to a free cooling box. While it cools, the furnace can receive another batch.
The two furnaces and two boxes share one car. Schedule a free box and time for the transfer before discharging the next batch.

cards.title: Supply responsibilities
definitions: Supplies furnaces, cooling boxes, the fork car and five sets of trays. Assists with loaded commissioning and performance checks.
Provides trial billets, utilities and consumables. Both parties agree the quantity, quality and dimensions of the trial charge.

cards.title: Scope of supply
paragraphs: Suneng supplies two gas-fired furnaces, two enclosed cooling boxes and one charging car. The quotation includes five sets of heat-resistant steel trays with two pieces in each set.

cards.title: Acceptance procedure
definitions: Both parties specify the trial charge. The buyer supplies the agreed material.
The agreement requires two trial batches and compliance with the performance criteria. The number refers to batches tested.

figure.alt: Two gas furnaces and two cooling boxes
figure.caption: Heat the batches before transfer to enclosed cooling. The same car transfers batches between both furnaces and both boxes. A box can take the next batch after the cooled batch is removed.

related: Are two cooling boxes enough for two fork-handling furnaces?
forkReview.faqIntro: Shared handling, the interval between batches and trial conditions.
faq: How many fork cars and trays serve the two furnaces?
One car and five sets of heat-resistant steel trays. Each set comprises two pieces. The trays are included in Suneng’s quoted supply.
Can the hourly intake be calculated from the number of boxes?
Two boxes provide two cooling positions. Intake intervals also depend on cooling occupancy and loading and unloading time. See the related scheduling article for an example.
Who provides the billets and how many batches are tested?
The buyer provides billets, utilities and consumables. Both parties agree the charge, run two trial batches and check the specified performance.
forkReview.source: Reference: 2020 gas-fired production-line technical agreement. Furnace parameters are on p. 4; trial conditions are in the acceptance terms. Suneng’s engineering records confirm the tray quantities, supplier and inclusion in the quotation.
